system.description:
Freeze a target unit in place, preventing them from moving. On a failed Mgt saving throw (6 + caster Wit), the target is locked in a Stasis field and cannot take any actions, including counterattacks. On a successful saving throw, the target cannot Move, but may still take their standard or bonus action. This effect lasts for 1 turn. 

 Uses: 1 per Arcane rank

A mighty pillar of flame.

Gain 2 additional uses of this spell for each Elemental Proficiency rank above C.
Launch a cordon of arcane bolts that home in and follow your target, ensuring a nigh guaranteed hit.

Casts a burst of wind that knocks flyers out of the sky.

Effective against Flying units. On hit against standard sized units, has a 50% chance to Unbalance the target. Unbalanced units do not apply their Agi bonus to their total Eva.

Nullify a target's ability to cast spells. The target must succeed a Wit Saving Throw (DC = 8 + Caster Wit), or else they cannot use any magic for 2 turns. On a successful save, they ignore this effect.
Robes made with thick fabrics and lined with hides. Offers impressive defense against physical attacks at the lightest possible burden.
